summary: Iteration 32 FULL PASS — retention + save-loop fixes verified end-to-end. BACKEND (backend_iteration32_test.py, 12/12 in ~1.4s): (1) TestShiftsRetention: GET /api/shifts (default) returns only planned/active (asserted for every row); GET /api/shifts?include_ended=true returns the same list PLUS ended shifts (proved by starting + PATCH /shifts/{id}/end on a fresh shift, then confirming its id is absent from the default list but present with status=ended in the include_ended=true list; also confirmed invoice_count + total retention fields are present on the ended shift); include_ended=false is equivalent to omitting the flag (id-set equality). (2) TestRetentionIndexes: source scan confirmed every 'expireAfterSeconds' index in server.py is scoped ONLY to user_sessions or twofa_challenges — no TTL leaked onto invoices/tasks/shifts/receipts/client_notes/expenses. (3) TestListEndpointsRespondOk: GET /api/invoices, /api/receipts, /api/expenses, /api/tasks, /api/reminders, /api/clients/{id}/notes, /api/clients/{id}/overview all respond 200 with list/dict payloads under the raised 20000 cap. (4) TestSourceListCaps: source-code assertion that list_invoices/list_receipts/list_expenses/list_tasks/list_reminders/list_client_notes/client_overview handlers all call to_list(20000). FRONTEND (390x844, owner TEST_USER/admin): (A) Login → consent → onboarding-skip → dashboard-screen. (B) SHIFTS tab (via direct /(tabs)/shift route + tool-account style nav): toggle-shift-history header PRESENT reading 'Past shifts · 3'; tap expands and reveals 3 past-shift-<id> rows each showing DMY date, $amount, and 'N invoices captured' — copy 'Ended shifts stay on record for 7 years (Aus business compliance). Tap to view.' also renders. (C) PLANNER tab: exactly 28 day pills present, testIDs day-2026-07-07 … day-2026-08-03 (= 7 past + today 2026-07-14 + 20 forward). Auto-scroll on mount fires (scrollTo x=7*68=476 on requestAnimationFrame) so today sits at the left edge with past days visible only by back-scrolling; tapping the leftmost past pill day-2026-07-07 caused the day view to load without error, and the tapped pill became active. (D) ACCOUNT tab (direct /account nav): account-retention testID PRESENT beneath account-privacy-policy at y≈1018, rendering the retentionNote copy 'Your records (invoices, receipts, notes, shifts, planner) are retained for 7 years to meet Australian business record-keeping obligations.' with the shield-checkmark icon. (E) INVOICE REGRESSION: /invoice/new opens instantly with Save + Send now + Delete buttons rendered, TTP toggle, plan-management chips (Self/Plan managed/NDIA), and the compliance panel — no loading loop observed (api.ts:147-165 wraps fetch in AbortController with 45s timeout that falls back to enqueue on AbortError, so a stalled network no longer traps the UI). No React Native red screens. Deprecated packages check: no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports.
